title: BGVD-State: Evidence-lifecycle middleware for verifier-gated handoff in defensive LLM security agents
description: Model-independent, deterministic middleware for recording defensive security-agent events, preserving candidate and failed-path lifecycle, binding material and verifier evidence, rejecting stale evidence, enforcing verifier-gated finalization, and building weak-to-strong handoff packets. The repository also contains sanitized replay fixtures and an offline artifact validator. It contains no live targets, credentials, operational exploit commands, network addresses, or target-specific reproduction procedures.
